pairs.evidence: src/lib/judge/spendMeter.ts:163 The headless judge fleet turns the interactive preflight warning into a hard refusal with printed reasons. Verdicts are append-only and bound to content hash and rubric version, and judge calibration requires agreement with human labels that only an explicit operator act can confirm.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/judge/spendMeter.ts:163 With nobody to answer a confirm, warn becomes refuse, and the reasons are returned so the denial is never silent.
src/lib/judge/spendMeter.ts:154 Spending beyond budget needs an explicit operator force flag and is never granted by default.
src/lib/judge/spendMeter.ts:196 The unattended run has a ceiling in dollars and a stop that trips. Overshoot after the stop is recorded, so ungated is not unrecorded.
src/lib/judge/verdictStanding.ts:4 Verdicts are appended, and superseded or stale rows are kept as evidence rather than edited.

src/lib/judge/verdictStanding.ts:41 A verdict under a rubric that is not in force keeps only its refusing arm. The general judge pass is a recoverable content acceptance, not a trust-boundary admission.
src/lib/craft/craftCell.ts:118 An unknown content binding resolves to unknown, never to the cheap 'same'. verdictStanding:61 keeps an unknown-binding verdict condemning.
src/lib/judge/calibration.ts:29 Only a content-bound operator label moves a calibration target from provisional to confirmed. A source edit cannot.
src/lib/judge/calibration.ts:37 The judge is checked against a named oracle, confirmed human bands, with an enforced threshold.

pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/steps/shared/genHistory.ts:69 The Items gallery steps (Icon 2D, 3D Generation, Material) declare an L1 human-selection gate, but appendBatch auto-selects the first candidate on Produce and acceptance passes on that machine pick. The code keeps it that way because 'requiring a click would break the e2e walker', which only calls produceStep (catalog-pipeline-walker.spec.ts:68). The gated party opens its own gate; the SELECTION: AUTO chip records this but does not close the gate.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/steps/shared/genHistory.ts:69 The machine-produced selection satisfies a human-only transition. Provenance is recorded, but acceptance is unchanged.
src/components/layout-lab/steps/ItemGate.tsx:23 A check that cannot be observed reads DEFER, and any non-deferred blocker reads FAIL. Uncertainty never resolves to PASS.
